title: REQ · Empty loaded history shows 'No suggestions yet this round' and hides once an entry exists
summary: Empty state is derived from historyStatus === 'ready' and entries.length === 0
description: Context: ContributionSheet.tsx renders the entries list unconditionally and has no empty state. Desired behavior: render a paragraph with the exact text 'No suggestions yet this round' only while historyStatus is 'ready' and entries is empty. Expected result: it appears after an empty successful load and disappears when any entry is added. Why: gives the player clear feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Given historyStatus is 'ready' and entries is empty, when rendered, then 'No suggestions yet this round' is shown with role=status.
Given the message is shown, when a submission adds an entry, then the message is removed.
Given historyStatus is 'loading' or 'error', when entries is empty, then the message is not rendered.
technical_constraints: Derive from existing state; do not add a new state variable
